                            <div class="text-content"><p>Central Highlands Regional Council holds a general meeting on the <strong>4th Wednesday</strong> of each month.</p>
<p>Meetings begin at <strong>9.00 am</strong> and are held in the council chambers, corner of Egerton and Borilla Streets, Emerald (unless otherwise advised).</p>
<p>With the exception of items discussed in a ‘closed’ session, meetings are open to the public.</p>
<p><strong>Watch council meetings live as they happen or catch up on recorded meetings on council’s YouTube channel. </strong></p>
